Record Class PythonDiagnostic

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.diagnostic.PythonDiagnostic
Record Components:
kind - Whether the problem fails the compilation or is only reported
rule - The stable identifier of the check that found the problem, such as unresolved-import
message - The message, without a location
span - Where the problem is, or null when it has no position
suggestions - Alternatives the message may offer, such as similarly named members
public record PythonDiagnostic(PythonDiagnostic.Kind kind, String rule, String message, @Nullable SourceSpan span, List<String> suggestions) extends Record
A problem found in a Python source at compile time, located in that source.
Since:
5.3.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
